ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a 3-bit counter composed of three T flip-flops. The outputs of the three flip-flops are labeled P, Q, and R respectively, and their inverted outputs P', Q', and R' are also labeled. From the connections in the figure, R is fed back to the T input of the first flip-flop, so T_P = R; P' is connected to the T input of the second flip-flop, so T_Q = P'; Q' is connected to the T input of the third flip-flop, so T_R = Q'. Reasoning: A T flip-flop satisfies next = present XOR T, therefore P_next = P XOR R, Q_next = Q XOR P', and R_next = R XOR Q'. Initial PQR = 000: P_next = 0 XOR 0 = 0, Q_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1, R_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1, so the first state is 011. Starting from 011: P_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1, Q_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0, R_next = 1 XOR 0 = 1, so the second state is 101. Starting from 101: P_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0, Q_next = 0 XOR 0 = 0, R_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0, so the third state is 000.

raw_record.question_text: Consider a 3-bit counter, designed using T flip-flops, as shown in the image. Assuming the initial state of the counter given by PQR is 000, what are the next three states of the counter in order?

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit connections from the image. Convert them into T-input equations: T_P=R, T_Q=P', and T_R=Q'. Then use P_next=P XOR R, Q_next=Q XOR P', and R_next=R XOR Q'. Starting from PQR=000, apply these equations once per clock pulse for three pulses to obtain the next three states in order.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个由三个 T 触发器组成的 3-bit counter，三个触发器的输出分别标为 P、Q、R，并且各自也标出了反相输出 P'、Q'、R'。从图中的连线看，R 反馈到第一个触发器的 T 输入，所以 T_P = R；P' 接到第二个触发器的 T 输入，所以 T_Q = P'；Q' 接到第三个触发器的 T 输入，所以 T_R = Q'。推理：T 触发器满足 next = present XOR T，因此 P_next = P XOR R，Q_next = Q XOR P'，R_next = R XOR Q'。初始 PQR = 000：P_next = 0 XOR 0 = 0，Q_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1，R_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1，所以第一状态为 011。由 011 出发：P_next = 0 XOR 1 = 1，Q_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0，R_next = 1 XOR 0 = 1，所以第二状态为 101。由 101 出发：P_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0，Q_next = 0 XOR 0 = 0，R_next = 1 XOR 1 = 0，所以第三状态为 000。
